mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_medicines (user_id, medicine_id, custom_name, type, spec, package_unit, package_quantity, dose_unit, dosage_per_time, frequency_per_day, reminder_times, total_packages, total_stock, current_stock, threshold_days, start_date, end_date, status, precautions, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{medicineId}, #{customName}, #{type}, #{spec}, #{packageUnit}, #{packageQuantity}, #{doseUnit}, #{dosagePerTime}, #{frequencyPerDay}, #{reminderTimes}, #{totalPackages}, #{totalStock}, #{currentStock}, #{thresholdDays}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{precautions}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_medicines SET custom_name = #{customName}, type = #{type}, spec = #{spec}, package_unit = #{packageUnit}, package_quantity = #{packageQuantity}, dose_unit = #{doseUnit}, dosage_per_time = #{dosagePerTime}, frequency_per_day = #{frequencyPerDay}, reminder_times = #{reminderTimes}, total_packages = #{totalPackages}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, current_stock = #{currentStock}, threshold_days = #{thresholdDays}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, precautions = #{precautions}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT um.*, mi.name as medicine_name, mi.barcode, mi.drug_instruction, mi.indication FROM user_medicines um LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.id = #{id}
SELECT um.*, mi.name as medicine_name, mi.barcode, mi.drug_instruction, mi.indication FROM user_medicines um LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT um.*, mi.name as medicine_name, mi.barcode, mi.drug_instruction, mi.indication FROM user_medicines um LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.status = 1 AND (um.is_deleted = 0 OR um.is_deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY um.create_time DESC

SELECT um.*, mi.name as medicine_name, mi.barcode, mi.drug_instruction, mi.indication FROM user_medicines um LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.status = 1 AND (um.is_deleted = 0 OR um.is_deleted IS NULL) AND um.current_stock / (um.dosage_per_time * um.frequency_per_day) <= #{thresholdDays} ORDER BY um.current_stock ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_medicines SET current_stock = #{currentStock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
